_purpose: Round 140 — Verified Patterns System feature flags. Read by Cura (Architectural sub-check) and Vision (Phase 1 scan) at session start. If a flag is `false`, the corresponding pattern-search question is SKIPPED entirely in that mode's prompt.
_rollback: To disable the entire Verified Patterns System without removing code: set both `cura_pattern_search.enabled` and `vision_pattern_seed.enabled` to false. To remove the feature entirely: see memory/essence/saga.md Round 140 entry, § Rollback recipe.
_owner: user-controlled via co-work request (e.g., 'turn off Cura pattern suggestions')

cura_pattern_search.description: Cura's Architectural sub-check includes the question: 'Does this candidate solve a problem for which a verified pattern already exists in memory/verified-patterns.md?' If a verified pattern fits, the LAND reduces to parameter-tuning rather than full re-derivation.

vision_pattern_seed.description: Vision's Phase 1 scan includes the question: 'Is there a design surface that would benefit from a seed-from-pattern proposal?' Hard cap: ONE candidate per night (not 'convert all N surfaces'). The proposal is a SEED — human verifies rendered output before any propagation. Vision NEVER proposes batch conversion.

cura_security_subcheck.description: Cura's 6th Phase-1 sub-check — Security. Scans dashboard.html + tools/* + cart import path for input-validation gaps, XSS vectors, missing SRI hashes, mutable window exports, schema-validation gaps. Cap: 1 LAND per night unless critical finding (CRIT_OVERRIDE noted explicitly in the candidate). Rotation cursor at tacitus/security-audit-cursor.json scopes which surfaces are audited tonight (full set audited once per ~3 weeks at the rotation cadence). Set false to disable entirely.

design_system_enforcement.description: Design System v3 strictness knob. Three modes: 'warn' = invariants surface findings as warnings (always PASS, payload notes violations), 'error' = invariants FAIL on violation (critical/warning severity per invariant), 'off' = checks skipped entirely. Initial mode is 'warn' for the first 3 rounds of migration. Promote to 'error' once dashboard.html no longer has external-resource imports and uses tokens for all visual values. Three paired invariants read this flag: check_no_external_style_resources, check_design_system_hash_integrity, check_design_system_write_protection.
design_system_enforcement.last_changed_by: Round 161 sealing — all promotion criteria met
